title: Longest Univalue Path
summary: For a given binary tree, determine the length of the longest path where all nodes have identical values.
statement: For a given binary tree, determine the length of the longest path where all nodes have identical values. This path can originate from any node and does not necessarily include the root. The path length is measured by the count of edges connecting the nodes.
constraints: Return path length in edges; the path may join matching downward chains from both children through a node.
